rules.body: Apply when deferred document work belongs to an owner that outlives its current observer. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge." docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by the coordinator dictionary, while Badge owns only a live subscription."

Restart the document's quiet interval on each edit, retain the latest text, and keep the task reusable after consumption. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/services.js: "push(text) { if (ticket !== null) timers.cancel(ticket); value = text; ticket = timers.schedule(flush, wait); },"

Clear consumed pending state before invoking a callback that can synchronously reenter navigation, so outer cleanup cannot erase newly scheduled work. src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };" docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously."

Ending a view subscription must preserve its document owner's pending-save responsibility. Choose completion or continued scheduling consistently with the documented ownership; subscription cleanup alone does not justify discarding document edits. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge."

Preserve request identity across callback-capable departure work and check whether an open request was superseded before publishing its view. src/coordinator.js: "const mine=++request;retire();if(true&&mine!==request)return;" docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously."

Keep interfaces, identities, text, and status semantics intact. TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics."

Do not transfer document persistence policy to transient preview work or to another task with explicitly different ownership or discard rules. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};"

Check latest-value coalescing at the 120 ms boundary, later bursts, empty text, independent document IDs, and pending edits across switch, close, and reopen. Exercise synchronous save-listener open and close calls and verify that superseded outer navigation does not overwrite them. These checks derive from TASK's "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save.", README.md's "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge.", and docs/host-api.md's "A store listener may call navigation synchronously."

limitations: The task and ownership documents do not explicitly require pending saves to complete before departure returns. Synchronous departure flushing is one implementation choice; evaluation observations do not make it a business requirement.
Asynchronous decoding, subscription bootstrap publication, and visit-based publication permissions from the supplied experience are not established by this implementation.
Exception behavior and calls after disposal are unspecified.
Static findings are review hints. The supplied passing observations do not prove causality, exhaustive correctness, or benefit on other tasks.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
